correctness.rationale: Any shuffle of u=0^a1^b and v=1^c0^d (a,b,c,d≥1) must have exactly a zeros in its first a+c positions: fewer prevents u entering its one-run, more requires v to have exhausted its c one-run. Every x∈B(a,c), y∈B(d,b) has an explicit valid source assignment, hence L=B(a,c)B(d,b), fixed boundary, |L|=binom(a+c,a)binom(b+d,d). Prefix left quotients within each phase depend only on the remaining zero/one counts and are distinguished by required zero counts in the remaining phase; different total prefix lengths have different residual accepted lengths. The two count rectangles share one boundary quotient; adding a single dead quotient yields minimal complete DFA state complexity (a+1)(c+1)+(b+1)(d+1), all parameters positive. An independently implemented exhaustive shuffle and quotient-set enumeration verified both normal form and minimal states for all 81 parameter quadruples 1≤a,b,c,d≤3. Analytic Myhill–Nerode proof covers all positive integers.
